title: Carve 0.2 include expansion: failure causes and option conflicts
description: The causes that leave an include unexpanded, in the order they are tested (C2-N-061), and the combinations of selection, transform and mode that a directive may not hold (C2-N-024). `causes` is sorted by `rank`, `conflicts` by `name`.

rank.description: The place of the cause in the order of tests. The first cause that applies is reported and no later one is tested.

name.description: The cause. The four causes with stage `resolver` are the error causes a resolver returns (C2-N-007).

code.description: The code reported in the parse channel with severity warning. Two rows share `include-budget`: the size cap is one cause, tested before and after the resolver.

stage.description: before_resolver: tested without calling the resolver; the node has no `file`. resolver: returned by the resolver; the node has no `file`. after_resolver: tested on the returned text; the node keeps `file` (C2-N-062).

when.description: When the cause applies, in the words of the clauses.

rule.description: at_most_one: at most one of `options` stands in a directive. exclusive: the options of the list do not stand together. requires_table_code: the option needs `code` with the language `csv` or `tsv` and the `table` flag in the include's attributes.

options.description: `section` is the `#name` of the directive; the other names are rows of include-options.json.
